requirement_summary.text_fragment: FODS root element is <office:document> with office:mimetype attribute
FODS mimetype is application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet-flat-xml
Spreadsheet content is in <office:body>/<office:spreadsheet>
Sheets are <table:table> children of <office:spreadsheet>
Rows are <table:table-row> children of <table:table>
Cells are <table:table-cell> children of <table:table-row>
Cell text is in <text:p> children of <table:table-cell>
table:number-columns-repeated attribute expands a cell across N columns
table:formula contains formula in oooc: or of: namespace
office:value-type values: string, float, boolean, date, time, currency, percentage
table:table-column defines column properties including default-cell-style-name
table:number-rows-repeated attribute on table:table-row expands a row across N rows
Named ranges are in <table:named-expressions> containing <table:named-range> elements
Automatic styles in <office:automatic-styles> define inline styles for cells, rows, columns
Covered table cells are <table:covered-table-cell> elements representing cells spanned by a merge
